# Code of Conduct

Concord Loom is committed to a respectful, safe, and constructive community.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss ideas and evidence without attacking people.
- State uncertainty and distinguish observations from assumptions.
- Welcome questions from people with different experience and backgrounds.
- Respect privacy, consent, attribution, and project boundaries.
- Accept maintainers' moderation decisions and help repair harm when possible.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized attention, deliberate intimidation, doxxing, sustained disruption, and publishing another person's private information without permission are not tolerated. Bad-faith manipulation of evidence or authority records is also incompatible with this community.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately through the contact method listed in [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md). Do not use a public issue when doing so could expose a target or reporter.

Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, restrict participation, or ban accounts when necessary. They will consider context, severity, repeated behavior, safety, and the interests of affected people. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical; anonymity cannot be guaranteed when investigation or legal obligations require disclosure.

This code applies in repository spaces and when someone officially represents Concord Loom elsewhere.
